releaseNote.summary: A function whose rule-based inputSchema has no matching entry now rejects a request that carries a body with 400 Function:800006; it used to skip validation.

deprecations.replacement: Add a rule-less fallback entry as the last inputSchema entry to keep accepting unmatched callers
deprecations.message: A rule-based inputSchema whose entries all carry a rule and none match now rejects the request with 400 Function:800006; it used to skip validation.
